name: Comparison table
descriptor: Records as rows, chosen attributes as columns, and the best value in each numeric column marked.
verify_checks: comparison: the best-value maths is emitted
pros: side by side is the only honest way to compare
the best value is marked, so the eye does not have to hunt
columns are chosen in the spec, so the table stays readable
it scrolls horizontally rather than dropping columns
cons: one highlight direction per column: max or min, not both
no weighting, no scoring, no verdict
more than about six columns needs a wide screen
the marked value is not always the right choice, and the app does not say so
best_for: a shortlist of options with a few attributes
avoid_if: the decision needs weights, or the attributes are long text
